cases.name: codex-counterexample
cases.why: replace [0,2) then insert at 0: sequential L(1)=0, R(1)=2; ChangeSet.compose would give 1

cases.name: touching-sections
cases.why: one transaction whose sections touch at 2 (replace, insert, delete): never merged

cases.name: net-zero
cases.why: type then delete inside a span, and beside another: the map is identity, the effects are not

cases.name: multi-range
cases.why: three changes in one transaction, including an insertion at the end

cases.name: start-and-end
cases.why: insertions at gap 0 and gap lenA in one transaction: edge insertions stay outside normal spans

cases.name: cjk-emoji-rtl
cases.why: UTF-16 units: a surrogate pair replaced whole, CJK inserted, RTL text deleted

cases.name: empty-document
cases.why: lenA = 0: one gap, no characters; typing then clearing (the first window: basis genesis)

cases.name: delete-all-retype
cases.why: the text of a normal span deleted and re-typed: the span inverts (from > to), text unknown

cases.name: bounded-break
cases.why: an uncertified replacement of [2,3): spans whose mapped positions meet it are blocked, others map exactly

cases.name: inverted-span-meets-bounded-break
cases.why: a span given inverted (from > to, as an earlier window can map it) is blocked when its gaps [lo, hi] meet a bounded break, as if written the other way round

cases.name: whole-break-keeps-first-reason
cases.why: a snapshot-only update then an external reload: the first reason stays, every span is blocked

cases.name: cap-overflow
cases.why: cap 8, nine disjoint deletions: at least nine deletedChars intervals in any representation, so a whole break capOverflow/accumulator

writerCases.name: writer-review-no-map
writerCases.why: an agent whole-document write with no map: a whole break {wholeDocumentWrite, agent}; no epoch armed, so epoch "0"

writerCases.name: writer-none-no-map
writerCases.why: a save with no map: a whole break {snapshotOnly, snapshot}; built on pending observation o0001 while epoch 7 is armed

writerCases.name: writer-restore
writerCases.why: a restore never carries a worker map: a whole break {restore, restore}

writerCases.name: writer-concurrent-observation
writerCases.why: a save captured on a revision that is no longer the head: {parentMismatch, concurrentObservation}

writerCases.name: writer-gap
writerCases.why: a save captured on a revision the journal never recorded: {parentMismatch, gap}

writerCases.name: writer-hunk-revert
writerCases.why: a hunk revert is one certified change the writer builds from the hunk; epoch "0" when none is armed

writerCases.name: genesis-first-window
writerCases.why: the first window of a new document maps from genesis: basis "genesis", preimage empty

textChecks.name: replace-honest
textChecks.why: replace b with X; a and c survive in place

textChecks.name: replace-lie
textChecks.why: the same map over Xbc: hashes and lengths match, but a does not survive
textChecks.error: original character 0 survives the map but not the texts

textChecks.name: insert-moved
textChecks.why: the map inserts at 0 but the text has it at the end
textChecks.error: original character 0 survives the map but not the texts

textChecks.name: surrogate-unit
textChecks.why: UTF-16 units: the low surrogate of the surviving emoji changed (😀 → 😁)
textChecks.error: original character 1 survives the map but not the texts

textChecks.name: whole-break-any-text
textChecks.why: a whole break keeps no character, so any texts agree

workerPayloads.name: accepted
workerPayloads.why: names this document, the open epoch, the head, and maps these texts

workerPayloads.name: pending-basis
workerPayloads.why: a save built on pending observation o0001 names it as basis

workerPayloads.name: genesis-basis
workerPayloads.why: the first window of a document names genesis

workerPayloads.name: no-epoch-armed
workerPayloads.why: no epoch is armed: no worker map counts

workerPayloads.name: writer-epoch-zero
workerPayloads.why: "0" is the writer's no-epoch marker, never a worker's epoch

workerPayloads.name: another-epoch
workerPayloads.why: an epoch other than the open one (closed, or not yet armed)

workerPayloads.name: another-basis
workerPayloads.why: a map built on another revision

workerPayloads.name: genesis-after-first-revision
workerPayloads.why: genesis once the document has a revision

workerPayloads.name: another-preimage
workerPayloads.why: hashes bind the map to its preimage

workerPayloads.name: lying-map
workerPayloads.why: hashes and lengths match, a surviving character does not

mappedSpans.name: certified-shift
mappedSpans.why: a certified insertion before the span shifts it; no block, no lastCertified

mappedSpans.name: first-block-records-lastCertified
mappedSpans.why: a whole break: the block arrives with lastCertified at the parent, the old range

mappedSpans.name: block-and-lastCertified-are-sticky
mappedSpans.why: a later break keeps the first block and its lastCertified; the range still maps

mappedSpans.name: certified-after-block-keeps-it
mappedSpans.why: a certified edit after the block clears nothing

mappedSpans.name: bounded-break-reaches
mappedSpans.why: an uncertified range over the span blocks it; lastCertified at the parent

mappedSpans.name: bounded-break-elsewhere
mappedSpans.why: an uncertified range elsewhere leaves the span certified

mappedSpans.name: growing-anchor-blocked
mappedSpans.why: a deletion anchor reached by a whole break records its empty range

mappedSpans.name: v1-block-without-lastCertified
mappedSpans.why: a block decoded from a v1 history has no lastCertified, and none is invented

mappedSpans.name: no-parent-is-an-error
mappedSpans.why: a span cannot exist before any revision: a block reaching one with no parent is refused

mappedSpans.name: snapshot-block-pins-lastCertified
mappedSpans.why: a snapshot save blocks the span at its parent; that parent is pinned while the hunk is live
